Metadata.title: Claude Code Quiz for Data
Metadata.description: A True or False quiz about Claude Code for data engineers, analysts and scientists.

Footer.disclaimer: Independent project, not officially affiliated with Anthropic.

Home.title: Claude Code Quiz for Data Professionals
Home.subtitle: Test what you know about Claude Code in real data scenarios: SQL, dbt, notebooks, pipelines and warehouses. 15 True or False statements, with an explanation and a docs link after each answer.
Home.whatIs: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool: it reads your repository, edits files and runs commands from natural-language instructions.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: MCP with databases and warehouses, hooks, permission rules, subagents, skills, non-interactive mode in CI and orchestrators, GitHub Actions and the Agent SDK.
